Tilt training images as if seen from another angle, at random.

With the given probability, each corner of a training image moves inwards by up to distortion of half the side and the image follows (torchvision RandomPerspective); pixels from outside the image take fill. Validation and test images pass through unchanged.

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Images, same shape |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Distortion | `distortion` | Number | `0.5` | `0-1` | The run | How far the corners may move, 0 to 1. |
| Probability | `probability` | Number | `0.5` | `0-1` | The run | Chance that a training image is tilted. |
| Interpolation | `interpolation` | Choice | `bilinear` | `bilinear`, `nearest` | The run | Pixel sampling. |
| Fill | `fill` | Number | `0` | `0-1` | The run | Value of the pixels from outside the image (0 = black) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Random Perspective is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Random Perspective -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
With the given probability each corner moves inwards by up to distortion of half the side; pixels from outside the image take fill. Validation and test pass through.
```

## Tips

- Suits photos of flat things (documents, signs) taken at an angle.
